Title: Kinetic Charging Mutation
Description:
New mental mutation Kinetic Charging!

Kinetic Throw: Charge throwable items to detonate on impact for explosive area damage.

Kinetic Bomb
  Infuse adjacent furniture or walls with kinetic energy that detonates after a 3-turn delay.

Kinetic Weapon
  A toggleable ability adding a melee damage bonus scaled by mutation level.
